notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each +1/+1 counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
